column2:
訂位、預約
/ˌrɛzɚˈveʃən/
例I made a reservation for four at seven o'clock.
影片I'd like to make a reservation for two.
補充固定搭配 make / cancel / confirm a reservation；動詞為 reserve。

今日特餐、主廚推薦菜
/ˈspɛʃəlz/
例The specials are written on the board by the door.
影片What are today's specials?
注意熟字生義：special 當名詞複數指餐廳的當日特餐，不是「特別的」。

一道菜、菜餚
/dɪʃ/
例This dish is made with fresh local vegetables.
影片Could you tell me more about this dish?
注意熟字生義：餐廳語境幾乎都指「菜餚」而非「盤子」。

對…過敏
/əˈlɝdʒɪk/
例She's allergic to shellfish, so we avoid seafood places.
影片I'm allergic to peanuts. Does this dish contain any?
注意形容詞重音在第二音節 /əˈlɝdʒɪk/，名詞 allergy 卻在第一音節 /ˈælɚdʒi/。

（牛排）三分熟
/ˈmidiəm ˈrɛr/
例How would you like your steak? Medium rare, please.
影片I'll have the steak medium rare.
補充熟度由生到熟：rare → medium rare → medium → medium well → well done。

沙拉醬、調味醬
/ˈdrɛsɪŋ/
例What kind of dressing comes with the house salad?
影片Could I have the dressing on the side?
注意熟字生義：與 dress（穿衣）無關，指淋在沙拉上的醬汁。

醬料另外附上、放旁邊
/ɑn ðə ˈsaɪd/
例I'd like the gravy on the side, please.
影片Can you bring the sauce on the side?
補充也可指「另加一份附餐」：a salad on the side。

素食者；素食的
/ˌvɛdʒəˈtɛriən/
例The menu marks all vegetarian dishes with a green leaf.
影片I'm a vegetarian. Do you have vegetarian options?
注意共五音節，重音在第三音節 -tar-。

乳製品（的）
/ˈdɛri/
例I try to cut down on dairy products.
影片Can you make this dish without dairy?
注意與 diary（日記 /ˈdaɪəri/）拼字近似，但音節數與發音完全不同。

全素者；全素的（不含蛋奶）
/ˈvigən/
例A vegan diet excludes eggs, milk, and honey.
影片Do you have any vegan desserts?
注意讀作「VEE-gun」，重音在前；比 vegetarian 嚴格，蛋奶皆不吃。

選項、可供選擇的餐點
/ˈɑpʃən/
例The lunch set gives you three options for the main course.
影片Do you offer any gluten-free options?
補充形容詞 optional＝可選的、非必要的。

帳單（美式）
/tʃɛk/
例Could we get the check when you have a moment?
影片Can I have the check, please?
注意熟字生義：美式餐廳帳單說 check，英式說 bill。

分攤帳單
/splɪt ðə ˈbɪl/
例Shall we split the bill three ways?
影片Could we split the bill?
補充同義說法 go Dutch；請服務生分開結帳可說 Separate checks, please.

剩菜
/ˈlɛftˌovɚz/
例We packed the leftovers and had them for lunch.
影片Can I take the leftovers home?
補充恆用複數；要打包盒可說 Could I get a to-go box?

幼兒餐椅
/ˈhaɪ ˌtʃɛr/
例Could we get a high chair for our toddler?
影片Do you have high chairs for children?
注意是固定名詞，不是「很高的椅子」。

服裝規定
/ˈdrɛs ˌkod/
例The restaurant has a strict dress code — no shorts.
影片Is there a dress code for the restaurant?
補充常見等級：casual、smart casual、business casual、formal。

微冷的、涼颼颼的
/ˈtʃɪli/
例It gets chilly near the window at night.
影片It's a bit chilly here. Could we move to another table?
注意與 chili（辣椒）幾乎同音，只能靠語境分辨。

與…相配（餐點與酒水）
/ˈgo wɪð/
例A crisp white wine goes well with grilled fish.
影片Could you recommend a good wine to go with my meal?
補充同義 pair with、match；常插入 well 加強。

無麩質的
/ˈglutn̩ ˌfri/
例They bake a gluten-free version of every dessert.
影片Do you offer any gluten-free options?
補充-free 構詞家族：sugar-free、dairy-free、nut-free、alcohol-free。

開胃菜
/ˈæpəˌtaɪzɚ/
例We ordered three appetizers to share before the mains.
影片We would like to start with some appetizers.
補充源自 appetite（食慾）；英式菜單多用 starter。

前菜、開胃菜（英式）
/ˈstɑrtɚ/
例The soup makes a good starter on a cold night.
影片Can you recommend a starter?
注意熟字生義：菜單上指第一道菜，與「起動裝置、發起者」無關。

今日例湯
/ˈsup əv ðə ˈde/
例The soup of the day is roasted pumpkin.
影片What's the soup of the day?
補充同構說法：catch of the day、special of the day。

脫脂牛奶
/ˈskɪm ˌmɪlk/
例I always order my latte with skim milk.
影片I'd like my coffee with skim milk, please.
補充skim 原意「撇去表層油脂」；英式作 skimmed milk。

酒水優惠時段
/ˈhæpi ˌaʊr/
例Happy hour runs from five to seven on weekdays.
影片Is there a happy hour menu?
補充通常是傍晚的折扣時段，實際長度未必只有一小時。

續杯、再加一杯
/ˈriˌfɪl/
例Coffee refills are free all day.
影片Can I get a refill on my drink?
注意名詞重音在前 /ˈriˌfɪl/，動詞在後 /riˈfɪl/。

（食物）清淡的、不油膩的
/laɪt/
例After a heavy lunch I just want something light.
影片I'm looking for something light. What do you suggest?
注意熟字生義：不是「輕的、光線」，而是口味清淡；亦可修飾酒 a light red wine（口感輕盈的紅酒）。

油膩的
/ˈɔɪli/
例The noodles were tasty but a little too oily.
影片I'd like my meal to be less oily.
補充近義 greasy（語氣更負面）；反面說法為 light。

服務費
/ˈsɝvɪs ˌtʃɑrdʒ/
例A ten percent service charge is added automatically.
影片Is service charge included in the bill?
補充與 tip（自願給的小費）不同，service charge 是強制加收。

搖晃不穩的
/ˈwɑbli/
例One leg is shorter, which makes the table wobbly.
影片This table is a bit wobbly. Can we get another one?
補充動詞 wobble＝晃動、搖擺。

把（音量、溫度）調小
/ˌtɝn ˈdaʊn/
例Could you turn the air conditioning down a little?
影片Can you turn down the music a bit?
注意另有「拒絕」義：They turned down my offer.

讚美、致意
/ˈkɑmpləmɛnt/
例Please compliment the chef on the dessert.
影片I would like to compliment the chef.
注意影片字幕誤植為 complement（互補）；兩字同音但意思無關。

一份配菜
/ə ˈsaɪd əv/
例I'll take the burger with a side of coleslaw.
影片Can I have a side of fries with that?
補充名詞形式 side dish；side 單獨也可指配菜。

乳糖不耐的
/ˈlæktos ɪnˈtɑlərənt/
例He's lactose intolerant, so he takes his coffee black.
影片I forgot to mention I'm lactose intolerant.
補充名詞為 lactose intolerance；相關說法 dairy-free。

份量、一人份
/ˈpɔrʃən/
例The portions here are generous, so one dish is enough.
影片How big are the portions?
補充half portion＝半份；a tasting portion＝小份試吃量。

招牌菜、特色菜
/ˈspɛʃəlti/
例Grilled lamb is the specialty of this region.
影片I'd like to try a local specialty.
補充the specialty of the house＝本店招牌菜；英式拼作 speciality。

會員集點方案
/ˈlɔɪəlti ˌprogræm/
例Their loyalty program gives you a free meal after ten visits.
影片Do you have a loyalty program?
補充英式作 loyalty scheme；loyalty 源自 loyal（忠誠的）。

容納；滿足（需求）
/əˈkɑməˌdet/
例The private room can accommodate up to twenty guests.
影片Can you accommodate food allergies?
注意聽力上易與 accumulate（累積）混淆；拼字為雙 c 雙 m。

對調、換成
/swɑp/
例Can I swap the soup for a salad?
影片Can I swap the side dish that comes with my meal?
補充句型 swap A for B；口語中比 exchange 更常用。

早午餐
/brʌntʃ/
例We usually have brunch around eleven on Sundays.
影片Do you offer brunch on weekends?
注意breakfast＋lunch 的混成詞；影片字幕誤聽為 branch（分店）。

候位名單
/ˈwetɪŋ ˌlɪst/
例Put us on the waiting list — we don't mind waiting.
影片Is there a waiting list?
補充口語也說 waitlist；相關問法 How long is the wait?

飲料（正式用語）
/ˈbɛvərɪdʒ/
例The price includes one beverage of your choice.
影片Do you have any non-alcoholic beverages?
補充多見於菜單與告示；口語仍以 drink 為主。實際可讀成兩個半音節 /ˈbɛvrɪdʒ/。

主菜
/ˈmen ˌkɔrs/
例We'll order the main course after the appetizers arrive.
影片Can I have the salad as my main course?
補充美式菜單也用 entrée 表示主菜；course 此處指「一道餐」。

侍酒師
/ˌsʌməlˈje/
例The sommelier suggested a Riesling with the fish.
影片Do you have a sommelier to recommend wine?
注意法語外來字，字尾 -lier 讀 /je/，r 不發音，重音落在最後。

一輪酒（在座每人各一杯）
/ə ˈraʊnd əv ˈdrɪŋks/
例It's my turn to buy a round.
影片Can we order a round of drinks to start?
注意熟字生義：round 不是「圓的」，指「請全桌每人一杯」；亦可說 a round of appetizers。

加熱、熱一下
/ˌhit ˈʌp/
例Could you heat the soup up a bit? It's gone cold.
影片Can you heat this up a little more?
注意受詞為代名詞時必須放中間：heat it up，不可說 heat up it。

無酒精雞尾酒
/ˈmɑkˌtel/
例They serve a whole page of mocktails for non-drinkers.
影片Do you have a selection of mocktails?
注意mock（仿）＋cocktail 的混成詞；影片字幕誤聽成 mock tales。

自來水
/ˈtæp ˌwɔtɚ/
例Tap water is free, but bottled water costs extra.
影片Could you bring a jug of tap water for the table?
補充tap＝水龍頭；jug＝水壺（美式常說 pitcher）。對比 bottled / sparkling water。

非常想吃、渴望
/krev/
例I've been craving noodles all week.
影片I'm craving something sweet. What desserts do you have?
補充名詞 craving＝強烈的慾望，have a craving for chocolate。

（啤酒）桶裝現打的
/ɑn ˈtæp/
例They have six local beers on tap tonight.
影片Do you have any local beer on tap?
補充對比 bottled beer；draft beer 也是生啤的說法。

今日鮮魚
/ˈkætʃ əv ðə ˈde/
例The catch of the day is sea bass, grilled with lemon.
影片What's the catch of the day?
注意熟字生義：catch 在此是名詞「當日漁獲」，不是動詞「抓住」。

有節慶氣氛的
/ˈfɛstɪv/
例The dining room looked festive with candles and flowers.
影片We're celebrating. Could you bring us something festive?
補充同源詞 festival、festivity；the festive season＝歲末節慶期間。

餐酒搭配
/ˈpɛrɪŋ/
例The tasting menu comes with a wine pairing for each course.
影片Can you recommend a good pairing for the ribeye?
補充動詞用 pair with；ribeye /ˈraɪˌaɪ/＝肋眼牛排（影片字幕誤植）。

大拼盤
/ˈplætɚ/
例The cheese platter is enough for four people.
影片What's in the seafood platter?
補充比 plate 大，供多人分食；常見 seafood / cheese / fruit platter。

店家自製的
/ˈhaʊsˌmed/
例All the sauces here are house-made.
影片Do you have any house-made desserts?
注意與 housemaid（女傭）同音；影片字幕正是誤聽成 housemaid。house 系列還有 house wine、house salad。

人流、來往走動量
/ˈfʊt ˌtræfɪk/
例The shop moved to a street with more foot traffic.
影片We prefer to sit somewhere with less foot traffic.
注意熟字生義：traffic 在此指人的走動量，不是車流。

什錦的、各式各樣的
/əˈsɔrtɪd/
例The box contains assorted chocolates.
影片Can we get a plate of assorted cheeses?
補充名詞形 an assortment of＝一組各式各樣的，如 an assortment of desserts。

免費招待的
/ˌkɑmpləˈmɛntəri/
例Guests get a complimentary glass of champagne on arrival.
影片Is the bread basket complimentary?
注意與 complementary（互補的）同音；由 compliment 衍生，字面即「贈送以表心意」。

鹹香的、非甜口的
/ˈsevəri/
例The bakery sells both sweet and savory pastries.
影片Can we have a mix of sweet and savory for our breakfast?
補充與 sweet 相對的味覺分類；英式拼作 savoury。

餅皮、麵包外皮
/krʌst/
例I like the crust crispy but not burnt.
影片Can the pizza be made with a thin crust?
補充thin crust／thick crust；也指派皮 pie crust。形容詞 crusty＝外皮酥脆的。

替換、以…代替
/ˈsʌbstəˌtut/
例You can substitute brown rice for white rice.
影片Can I substitute the fries with a salad?
注意substitute A with B 與 substitute B for A 語序相反、意思相同，極易寫錯。

（餐點）豐盛管飽的
/ˈhɑrti/
例A hearty stew is perfect for a winter evening.
影片What are your best options for a hearty meal?
補充由 heart 衍生；另有「熱情的」義：a hearty welcome。與 light 恰成對比。

招牌的、最具代表性的
/ˈsɪgnətʃɚ/
例Every bartender here has a signature drink.
影片What's your signature cocktail?
注意熟字生義：不是「簽名」，而是「最能代表某人／某店的」；signature dish＝招牌菜。g 不發音。

餐巾
/ˈnæpkɪn/
例He folded his napkin and placed it on his lap.
影片Can we get some extra napkins?
補充布製 cloth napkin，紙製 paper napkin；英式亦稱 serviette。

帳單（英式）
/bɪl/
例The waiter brought the bill without being asked.
影片I think there's a mistake on the bill.
注意英式用 bill、美式多用 check；bill 在美式另指「鈔票」：a ten-dollar bill。

有機的
/ɔrˈgænɪk/
例The salad is made with organic greens from a local farm.
影片Do you serve organic food?
注意重音在第二音節 /ɔrˈgænɪk/，不在字首；名詞 organ 重音才在前。

折扣
/ˈdɪsˌkaʊnt/
例Students get a ten percent discount on weekdays.
影片Do you offer any discounts for large groups?
注意名詞重音在前 /ˈdɪsˌkaʊnt/，動詞在後 /dɪsˈkaʊnt/（另有「不予採信」義）。

桑格利亞水果酒
/sæŋˈgriə/
例We shared a pitcher of sangria on the terrace.
影片Can we have a pitcher of sangria?
注意西班牙紅酒加水果的調飲；影片字幕把 pitcher（大壺）誤聽成 picture。

肉汁醬
/ˈgrevi/
例The roast comes with mashed potatoes and gravy.
影片Can I have a little extra gravy on the side?
補充以烤肉滲出的肉汁加麵粉熬成的濃醬，與一般 sauce 不同。

清爽提神的
/rɪˈfrɛʃɪŋ/
例Iced mint tea is refreshing on a hot afternoon.
影片What's a refreshing drink to pair with our meal?
補充動詞 refresh；亦可指「令人耳目一新的」：a refreshing change。

舒適溫馨的
/ˈkozi/
例The corner booth is small but cozy.
影片We're looking for a cozy meal. Any suggestions?
補充英式拼作 cosy；強調「小而暖、令人放鬆」，不只是一般的舒服。

敢於嘗鮮的、口味大膽的
/ədˈvɛntʃərəs/
例If you're feeling adventurous, try the fermented tofu.
影片Do you have a dish that is a bit adventurous?
注意熟字生義：形容食物時指「口味不落俗套、需要一點膽量」，不是在說冒險活動。

事先、提前
/ɪn ədˈvæns/
例Group bookings must be paid two days in advance.
影片Can we order the cake in advance for a birthday?
補充常見搭配 book / pay / order… in advance；同義 ahead of time。

地點、位子
/spɑt/
例I know a quiet spot for lunch near the office.
影片We'd like a quiet spot away from the kitchen noise.
注意熟字生義：口語中常指「一個地方」，不是「斑點」；動詞 spot＝認出、發現。

可取得的、有空位的
/əˈveləbəl/
例Is there a table available at eight?
影片Can we have a window seat if available?
補充餐廳語境多指「還有空位／還供應」；名詞 availability。可後置修飾名詞：a table available at seven。

花生
/ˈpiˌnʌt/
例This sauce is made with crushed peanuts.
影片I'm allergic to peanuts. Does this dish contain any?
補充最常見的過敏原之一；相關說法 peanut allergy、nut-free。植物學上屬豆類，不是堅果。

額外的、多加的
/ˈɛkstrə/
例Could we get an extra chair, please?
影片Can we get some extra napkins?
補充點餐高頻字：extra cheese、extra ice、extra gravy。也可當名詞（額外收費項目）與副詞（格外地）。

海鮮
/ˈsiˌfud/
例The restaurant is known for its fresh seafood.
影片Do you have any seafood dishes?
注意不可數名詞，不加 s（不可說 seafoods）。細分有 shellfish（帶殼類）、shrimp、crab。

醬汁
/sɔs/
例The chicken comes with a creamy mushroom sauce.
影片Can you bring the sauce on the side?
注意美式發音與 source（來源 /sɔrs/）只差一個 r 音，sauce 不帶 r。比較 dressing（沙拉醬）、gravy（肉汁醬）。

信用卡
/ˈkrɛdɪt ˌkɑrd/
例Do you take credit cards, or is it cash only?
影片Can I pay by credit card?
補充介系詞固定為 pay by credit card，但付現是 pay in cash。相關 debit card（金融卡）。

包含、內含
/ɪnˈklud/
例Does the set meal include a drink?
影片Is service charge included in the bill?
補充問是否含稅含服務費時多用被動 be included；形容詞 inclusive，反義 exclude。

戶外的
/ˈaʊtˌdɔr/
例They have an outdoor terrace overlooking the river.
影片Do you have outdoor seating?
注意形容詞 outdoor 只放名詞前；副詞是 outdoors（字尾有 s）：Let's eat outdoors. 反義 indoor / indoors。

座位（整體配置與容量）
/ˈsitɪŋ/
例The café has limited seating during lunch hours.
影片Do you have outdoor seating?
注意不可數，指座位的整體安排，不是一張張的 seat（不可說 two seatings）。常見 seating area、seating capacity。

主廚
/ʃɛf/
例The chef came out to greet the guests.
影片I would like to compliment the chef.
注意法語外來字，ch 讀 /ʃ/ 而非 /tʃ/，聽起來像「shef」。指專業主廚，一般廚子為 cook。chef's special＝主廚特餐。

胡椒；甜椒、辣椒
/ˈpɛpɚ/
例Would you like some black pepper on your salad?
影片Can we get some fresh pepper here?
注意熟字生義：調味的胡椒為不可數；蔬菜甜椒／辣椒為可數（bell pepper、chili pepper）。固定搭配 salt and pepper。

慶祝、慶祝活動
/ˌsɛləˈbreʃən/
例The dinner was a celebration of their tenth anniversary.
影片I'd like to order a cake for a birthday celebration.
補充動詞 celebrate 後面直接接受詞，不加介系詞；片語 in celebration of＝為慶祝…。

一定、肯定地
/ˈdɛfənətli/
例I'll definitely recommend this place to my friends.
影片The food was excellent. We'll definitely come back.
注意重音在第一音節，中間弱音節在快速語流中幾乎被吞掉，聽起來像「DEF-nit-li」。拼字常誤寫成 definately。

提及、說到
/ˈmɛnʃən/
例She mentioned that the kitchen closes at ten.
影片I forgot to mention I'm lactose intolerant.
補充回應道謝的固定說法 Don't mention it.＝別客氣；片語 not to mention＝更不用說。

解釋、說明
/ɪkˈsplen/
例Could you explain what's in this sauce?
影片Can you explain how this dish is prepared?
注意不可說 explain me，必須是 explain to me，或 explain something to someone。名詞 explanation 重音落在 -na-。
